articles.title: Birthday Bashes Turn into Police Crackdowns in Bilaspur
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bilaspur – In Chhattisgarh’s Bilaspur, a late-night birthday celebration on August 7 turned chaotic when 10-12 youths blocked a road outside Galaxy Apartment, cutting a cake on a Bullet bike and bursting firecrackers, disrupting traffic for 20 minutes.

body.html:
Bilaspur – In Chhattisgarh’s Bilaspur, a late-night birthday celebration on August 7 turned chaotic when 10-12 youths blocked a road outside Galaxy Apartment, cutting a cake on a Bullet bike and bursting firecrackers, disrupting traffic for 20 minutes. Police arrived, seized the bike, arrested 10 boys, and paraded them publicly before making them apologise and pledge not to repeat the act. They were booked under BNS Sections 126(2), 285, and 3(5).

articles.title: Speeding AMC Garbage Truck Kills 51-Year-Old in Ahmedabad, Driver Lacked Licence
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Ahmedabad – A speeding Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation (AMC) garbage truck rammed into multiple vehicles in Jamalpur, killing 51-year-old Yasin Yusuf Barafwala and injuring three others. CCTV footage of the incident has gone viral.

body.html:
Ahmedabad – A speeding Ahmedabad Municipal Corporation (AMC) garbage truck rammed into multiple vehicles in Jamalpur, killing 51-year-old Yasin Yusuf Barafwala and injuring three others. CCTV footage of the incident has gone viral.

Police said the driver, Rahul Haresh Parmar, was driving without a valid licence and at excessive speed. He has been arrested and booked under multiple BNS sections, including culpable homicide not amounting to murder, rash driving, and provisions of the Motor Vehicles Act, following a complaint by the deceased’s son.

articles.title: Bhopal Govt School Teacher Caught on Video Getting Foot Massage from Student, Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bhopal – A video from Government Mahatma Gandhi Higher Secondary School in Gandhinagar has gone viral, showing a Class 4 student massaging the foot of a woman teacher during school hours. The incident reportedly occurred on Thursday but surfaced online on Saturday evening.

body.html:
Bhopal – A video from Government Mahatma Gandhi Higher Secondary School in Gandhinagar has gone viral, showing a Class 4 student massaging the foot of a woman teacher during school hours. The incident reportedly occurred on Thursday but surfaced online on Saturday evening.

In the video, the teacher is seen seated on a chair with her leg resting on another, while the child massages her foot. The teacher has denied wrongdoing, claiming she twisted her foot after stepping into a broken tile pit and that the student acted out of affection to ease her pain.

The matter has drawn criticism from residents, adding to ongoing concerns about teacher conduct and poor facilities in government schools across Madhya Pradesh.

articles.title: Delhi Crime Spree: ‘Mirchi Gang’ Strikes in Jahangirpuri, ‘Raincoat Gang’ Hits Laxmi Nagar
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: New Delhi – Two separate robbery incidents have reignited fears among Delhi residents. On Wednesday evening, the notorious Mirchi Gang struck again in Jahangirpuri’s E Block around 7:30 PM.

body.html:
New Delhi – Two separate robbery incidents have reignited fears among Delhi residents. On Wednesday evening, the notorious Mirchi Gang struck again in Jahangirpuri’s E Block around 7:30 PM. Four to five men on scooters and bikes allegedly stormed a grocery shop, threw chilli powder in the shopkeeper’s eyes, and looted cash and goods before fleeing within seconds. CCTV footage captured the entire act. Police are scanning the visuals and conducting raids to nab the culprits. Locals claim the gang has carried out similar attacks in the past, blinding victims before robbing them.

In a separate incident, the Raincoat Gang targeted a house in Laxmi Nagar in the early hours of 9 August, stealing cash and jewellery worth ₹50 lakh. CCTV footage shows several raincoat-clad thieves covering their faces and methodically executing the burglary.

Police have launched investigations into both cases, while residents and traders demand stronger security measures.

articles.title: Noida Crackdown: Fake ‘International Police’ Office Busted, 6 Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Noida, Uttar Pradesh – Police have busted a fake police office operating from a parlour in Noida under the name International Police & Crime Investigation Bureau.

body.html:
Noida, Uttar Pradesh – Police have busted a fake police office operating from a parlour in Noida under the name International Police & Crime Investigation Bureau. The gang falsely claimed affiliation with Interpol and Eurasia Pol, extorting money under the pretext of verifying police documents.

Six accused — Bibhash Chandra Adhikari, Aragya Adhikari, Babulchand Mandal, Pintumal, Samapadmal, and Ashish Kumar — have been arrested. Authorities recovered fake documents and seals printed in the name of several ministries.

articles.title: Rewa Scandal: OBC Mahasabha Leader Caught With Lover, Flees Scene
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Rewa, Madhya Pradesh – High drama unfolded in PM Awas Colony under Bichhiya police station when the wife of Pappu Kannaujiya, divisional president of the OBC Mahasabha, caught him red-handed with his lover late at night.

body.html:
Rewa, Madhya Pradesh – High drama unfolded in PM Awas Colony under Bichhiya police station when the wife of Pappu Kannaujiya, divisional president of the OBC Mahasabha, caught him red-handed with his lover late at night.

According to eyewitnesses, the wife, accompanied by her daughter, barged into the house and found Pappu in a compromising position. While he fled the spot, the wife assaulted the lover and created a commotion, drawing a large crowd. Locals allege Pappu had been in a long-term illicit relationship, hidden until this public exposure.

CSP Rewa Rajeev Pathak confirmed that videos of the incident have surfaced, and police are investigating the matter based on the footage and the complaint.
